transcript: I just launched a free website where you can find more than 500 prompts to create motion designs inside Claude, and you don't need any paid connectors or skill files. You can scroll through the library, check out the examples, and explore everything from minimal designs to complex animations. Or simply search for motion designs that fit your niche, such as product UI for your SaaS, diagrams for the explainer-style videos, characters for your faceless videos, and charts for data analysis and stats. All you have to do is click on the design you like, copy the prompt. Now open Claude and select model as Opus 5.5 and paste this prompt. Then make a few changes in the prompt as per the requirements and branding. And in a few minutes, you'll get a video like this. So if you want to check it out, link is pinned in the comment section. You're welcome.
